originStory.title: Born From a Startup That Never Launched
originStory.story:
In 2021, I set out to build a Knowledge Management platform. To do it right, I needed to understand everything about the PKM ecosystem—every tool, every methodology, every expert, every community. I spent over 12 months mapping the entire landscape, documenting thousands of resources in a Notion database.

The startup didn't get funded. But the research? That was gold.

I realized I had built something valuable: a comprehensive map of the PKM world that didn't exist anywhere else. The kind of resource I wished I had when I started my own PKM journey 20+ years ago. So I decided to share it.

The PKM Library isn't a side project or a quick list. It's the result of serious research conducted for a real business venture. And now it's yours.
originStory.inspirationPoint: When the startup fell through, I could have let this research gather dust. Instead, I turned months of work into something that helps others skip the same journey I took.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of PKM Exploration
creatorJourney.story: As a knowledge worker, author, and entrepreneur, I've spent over 20 years searching for better ways to manage information. I've tried dozens of tools—MediaWiki, TiddlyWiki, Evernote, OneNote, and many more—before finding what worked. I wasted years on approaches that didn't scale. I wished someone had mapped the landscape for me. This library represents everything I've learned about where to find quality PKM resources.
